title: ThaiGlowLite Shader
body:
ThaiGlow Lite Shader

ThaiGlow Lite Shader is a lightweight shader pack that enhances Minecraft's atmosphere with balanced lighting, realistic shadows, and smooth environmental effects while keeping performance as the top priority.

Designed for low-end and mid-range devices, it delivers a cleaner and more immersive visual experience without the heavy performance cost of high-end shaders.

Features

- 🌅 Balanced daylight with natural brightness
- 🌙 Darker, immersive nights while remaining playable
- 🌫️ Smooth atmospheric fog
- 🌄 Improved shadow quality
- 🎨 Natural color grading
- ⚡ Optimized for high FPS
- 📱 Great for low-end and mid-range PCs
- 🎮 Compatible with Iris Shaders and OptiFine

ThaiGlow Lite Shader focuses on providing a clean, realistic, and performance-friendly visual experience, making survival, exploration, and building more enjoyable without sacrificing smooth gameplay.

- Iris Shaders
